Subject: Next steps: decision lattice & champion enablement for Finexus pilot

Hi Oliver — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Recap (2 key threads)
- Business objective: reduce time-to-insight for credit-decisioning models by ~30% while cutting per-token infer costs for rule-based scoring.
- Constraints: PII redaction requirements, SOC 2 baseline, procurement prefers a short pilot + MSA.

Decision lattice (who decides what) — from the call:
- Economic/financial sign-off: Sanjay Rao (VP Finance) — cost/ROI threshold and internal budget owner.
- Security & data governance review: security@finexus / architecture team (we expect a formal questionnaire).
- Procurement/legal gate: procurement@finexus (MSA + SOW redline).
- Day-to-day champion: Oliver — will own pilot success criteria and internal evangelism.

Immediate asks / proposed timeline
1) Security review call (30–45m) — week of Nov 16. Neha can run through our evidence pack and talk-through of data flows.
2) Mutual Action Plan + champion enablement deck — I’ll share a one-pager ROI plus a draft MAP for alignment.
3) Procurement touchpoint — suggest a short intro email to procurement once they’ve had the security call.

Attachments: Finexus_ROI_onepager.pdf (ROI highlights), Finexus_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft MAP).

Could you confirm: 1) who on security should join the call (name + title + email), and 2) are there any non-negotiable legal terms we should be aware of?

Thanks — I’ll hold tentative slots Tue/Wed next week.

— Priyom

Oliver / Priyom — adding a short set of champion talk tracks and an ROI sketch to help Oliver when he syncs with Sanjay and the exec committee. Attaching the talk-tracks doc.

Champion talk tracks (short bullets for internal comms)
- Headline: Pilot will reduce scoring latency by ~30% and reduce inference cost by 20% through batching + prefix caching.
- Why now: model drift and seasonal spike costs are pushing up per-decision spend; a short pilot proves ops and cost delta.
- Ask for finance: approve $XXk pilot fund (covers 4 weeks of pilot + 1 week of integration support).
- Procurement ask: expedited MSA with a 30-day pilot SOW and limited data-processing scope.

ROI sketch (high level)
- Baseline cost: current per-decision inference cost = $0.012.
- Projected: $0.009 after batching/quantization at pilot scale.
- Run-rate delta: if 1M decisions/month, annualized savings ~ $36k.

Attachment: champion_talk_tracks.pdf

Next steps suggestion:
- Neha runs security evidence call with Kavita next Tue/Nov 16 (30m).
- I’ll prepare a concise one-page for Sanjay with spend tiers.
